steps.body: Use another “C” shaped line for the fluffy cotton tail.

steps.title: Your My Melody from Sanrio outline is now complete.
steps.body: Color your cute character. We’ve left Melody’s fur white and colored her hat pink.

lessons.title: Kuromi From Sanrio
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Kuromi from Sanrio with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Kuromi from Sanrio.

steps.title: Begin the Kuromi from Sanrio outline by drawing the eyes.
steps.body: First, draw two curved lines. Enclose a partial oval beneath each line, and shade them. Then, extend shorter lines from the side of the eye below the first. Draw a small oval in between the eyes to indicate the nose.

steps.title: Use two curved lines to create the open mouth.
steps.body: Then, encase the face in a large oval, leaving an opening at the top. Inside that opening, use four straight lines to create an incomplete diamond shape. Draw a small circle at the top of the diamond. This is the first of Kuromi’s ears.

steps.title: Use straight lines and a circle to enclose the second diamond-shaped ear.
steps.body: Draw a wide, curved “M” shaped line around the face.

steps.title: Enclose a skull on the front of Kuromi’s cap.
steps.body: Use a partial oval and curved lines to create the rectangular shape. Then, shade two oval-shaped eyes inside the skull.

steps.title: Draw the jester-like ruff or collar around Kuromi’s neck.
steps.body: Draw several small circles and connect them using “V” shaped lines.

steps.title: Complete the collar using a circle and straight lines.
steps.body: Then, use overlapping curved lines to draw Kuromi’s arm, her hand placed defiantly on her hip.

steps.title: Use curved lines to sketch the side of the torso and top of the leg, as well as the remaining arm, its hand on her hip.
Use curved lines to enclose Kuromi’s oval-shaped feet.
Use curved and straight lines to draw an arrow-shaped tail.
Color Your Kuromi from Sanrio Drawing

lessons.title: Bingo From Bluey
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Bingo from Bluey with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Bingo from Bluey.

steps.title: Begin the Bingo from Bluey outline by drawing Bingo's eye.
steps.body: Draw a small oval inside a larger oval and shade the small oval to indicate the pupil. Beside the eye, draw an inverted triangle with rounded corners. This is the dog's nose. Extend a straight line from the top and a curved line from the bottom of the nose to enclose the snout.

steps.title: Enclose the cartoon character's remaining eye above the snout using two partial ovals.
steps.body: Shade the smaller oval to indicate the pupil. Enclose a rounded shape above each eye to form the eyebrows. Draw a curved line at the corner of the mouth and from it extend a longer curved line to indicate the lower jaw. Connect the snout to the lower jaw with a short line, enclosing the teeth.

steps.title: Use curved lines to enclose Bingo's rounded rectangular body.
steps.body: Leave a section open on the side to make way for the arm. Then, from inside the body, extend two curved lines to form the arm. Use small "C" shaped lines to begin drawing the fingers.

steps.title: Use "C" shaped lines to draw the remaining fingers, fully enclosing the hand.
steps.body: Band the wrist with a curved line and draw another curved line across the palm. Then, use a pair of long curved lines and several "C" shaped lines to enclose the arm and hand on the opposite side.

steps.title: Band the wrist with a curved line and draw a short curved line across the Palm.
steps.body: Then draw the leg. Extend two straight lines from the body, and connect them with the curved line of the foot. Then, band the ankle with a curved line and use two curved lines to differentiate the toes.

steps.title: Draw the remaining leg.
steps.body: Again, extend two straight lines from the body, and connect them with the curved line of the foot. Then, band the ankle with a curved line and use two curved lines to differentiate the toes.

steps.title: Draw Bingo's ears.
steps.body: Enclose two curved triangles on top of the head, and draw smaller triangles inside each. Then extend a wavy curved line from the character's side to begin sketching the tail.

steps.title: Finishing enclosing Bingo's tail.
steps.body: Use a series of overlapping curved lines. Then, band the tip of the tail with a curved line and enclose a spot on its top.

steps.title: Complete your Bingo from Bluey outline by drawing her spots and markings.
steps.body: Use curved lines to enclose the belly, snout, around the eyes, and a spot on her back.

steps.title: Color your cartoon of Bingo from Bluey.
steps.body: This heeler pup is not blue at all - she is several shades of cream and orange, just like her mother, Chilli.

lessons.title: Love Birds
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Love Birds with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Love Birds.

steps.title: Begin by drawing a circle.
steps.body: This will outline the head of one of the birds.

steps.title: Draw a second circle, with a small portion eclipsed by the first.
steps.body: This will form the head of the second bird.

steps.title: Use long, curved lines to outline the first bird's body.
steps.body: Notice how the lines nearly meet. Then, draw a curved "M" shaped line to enclose the heart shaped tail at the end of the body.

steps.title: Repeat this process to draw the body of the second bird.
steps.body: First, draw two curved lines that nearly meet. Then, enclose the heart shaped tail.

steps.title: Erase the guide lines left by the original circles.
Draw the wings in the middle of the bodies, using two connected "U" shaped lines for each.
steps.body: Then, draw a crest of feathers upon the heads. For each crest, draw several connected, curved lines that double back sharply upon themselves. Erase guide lines as necessary.

steps.title: Draw feet beneath each bird.
steps.body: For each leg, extend a short, straight line downward from the body. Then, enclose a triangle to form the foot. Shade the triangle.

steps.title: Draw the faces of the love birds.
steps.body: To draw the beaks, sketch two curved triangle shapes. Notice that the triangles touch at the tip. Shade a small circle to represent each eye. Indicate eyebrows by placing a short, curved line above each eye.

steps.title: Give your birds something to stand on.
steps.body: Draw a tree branch by extending two long, parallel curved lines horizontally beneath the birds. Texture the branch's bark with swirls and curved lines.

steps.title: Color your love birds.
steps.body: In our example, we've shaded the birds pink and blue. In the wild, however, love birds may be green, blue, or grey, with patches of red, pink, black, white, or yellow.

lessons.title: Oggy From Oggy And The Cockroaches
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Oggy from Oggy and the Cockroaches with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Oggy from Oggy and the Cockroaches.

steps.title: Start by drawing a large bean shape with an oval on the right side.
steps.body: Draw two more ovals behind the bean shape to form the eyes. Make sure the first oval overlaps the second.

steps.title: Draw two smaller ovals inside these ovals, then draw smaller ovals and fill them in to make the pupils.
steps.body: Above the eyes, draw a partial heart shape that frames the ovals. Behind this shape, use straight and curved lines to form the back of the head with two points at the top.

steps.title: Draw a wide curve underneath the nose, then use curved lines to attach it to the top of the head.
steps.body: This should resemble a hot dog shape. Add two half-circles to the left side of the shape, then use straight lines to draw the whiskers.

steps.title: Underneath the bottom curve, draw two triangles to form the teeth.
steps.body: Make a long, sweeping curve that tapers upward to form the open mouth. On the bottom of this shape, draw two curved lines to make a tongue. These lines should resemble a small hillside.

steps.title: To add depth, draw a small curved line underneath the mouth.
steps.body: Draw a long shape that curves at the bottom and curves inward at the left to form the rest of the body. This shape resembles the base of a mushroom.

steps.title: Sketch two loosely L-shaped lines on the left side to form the arm.
steps.body: Use two C-shaped lines at the end of the arm to make the wrist. Using a series of curved lines and loose hook shapes, draw the fingers at the end of the arm. Make sure the fingers overlap.

steps.title: For the other arm, draw two short lines extending from the right side of the body.
steps.body: Draw two C-shapes to make the wrist. For the fingers, draw overlapping loops and hot dog shapes.

steps.title: Draw a swirl in the middle of the stomach.
steps.body: Surround this swirl with two broad curved lines.

steps.title: For the legs, draw two wide loops underneath the body.
steps.body: Draw two stretched-out bean shapes to form the feet, then use short lines to draw the toes. For the tail, use curved lines to make a long shape that looks like a hot dog that tapers down toward the body.

steps.title: Use blue to color the body and purple to color the inside of the mouth.
steps.body: You can use neon green for the eyes and bright red for the nose.

lessons.title: Mr Bean
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Mr. Bean with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Mr. Bean.

steps.title: Begin your caricature of Mr.
steps.body: Bean by drawing his eye. First, draw a large circle with a smaller circle inside it. Shade the smaller circle to indicate the pupil. Then, draw two "C" shaped or "U" shaped lines to form the nose. The line forming the tip of the nose should be larger than the one forming the nostril.

steps.title: Extend the line of the nose to curve upward, forming the brow above the remaining eye.
steps.body: Use a "C" shaped line to enclose a nostril barely visible on its other side. Then, enclose a partial circle shape against the nose to form the eye. Shade a smaller circle inside it to indicate the pupil.

steps.title: Draw a curved line to indicate the brow above the first eye.
steps.body: Shade a small oval along each brow line to form the eyebrows. Then use curved lines to form the smiling mouth, the dimple at the corner of the mouth, and the chin.

steps.title: Outline Mr.
steps.body: Bean's face. Use long curved lines to form the neck and cheek on one side and the neck, cheek, and forehead on the other. Shade a small circle to indicate a mole or freckle on one cheek.

steps.title: Draw Mr.
steps.body: Bean's large ears. Use a "C" shaped line to enclose each ear and a thick "C" shaped line to detail within it. Then, extend a long curved line from the edge of the forehead to begin drawing the hair.

steps.title: Use a series of long, connected curve lines to complete Mr.
steps.body: Bean's hair.

steps.title: Draw curved lines across the forehead, indicating wrinkles.
steps.body: Then, draw a series of straight and curved lines below the head, crossing over the neck. This outlines Mr. Bean's shoulders and jacket.

steps.title: Add detail to Mr.
steps.body: Bean's attire. Draw straight lines downward from the neck to form the opening of the jacket. Enclose two partial triangle shapes just below the neck to form the collars of the shirt. Use a "V" shaped line to enclose a diamond shape between them, and another "V" shaped line below this to form the necktie.

steps.title: Draw curved and zigzag lines across the shoulders on each side of the suit to form the lapel and the seam of the sleeves.
Your Mr.
steps.body: Bean outline is now complete. Color his black hair and brown suit.

categories.name: People
categories.description: People are a staple in many works of art. People, however, are often regarded as one of the most difficult things to draw well. However, it doesn't have to be that way. Our tutorials are designed to help you master the art of drawing people, one line or shape at a time.

lessons.title: A Head Outline
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Head Outline with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Head Outline.

steps.title: Begin the head outline by drawing the eye.
steps.body: Start with a sideways “V” shaped line. Draw a partial oval inside it, with a smaller oval within. Shade between the ovals, forming the pupil.

steps.title: Contour the eyelid with a curved line.
steps.body: Above the eye, draw the curved, bluntly pointed shape of the eyebrow using two curved lines. Draw a curved line in front of it, beginning the forehead.

steps.title: Extend the line of the forehead to form the nose.
steps.body: Draw a squiggly “S” shaped line to form the nostril.

steps.title: Draw another line from below the nose, forming the upper lip and a gentle smile.
steps.body: Draw a short line at the corner of the mouth. Then extend another long curved line from the front of it, enclosing the lower lip, chin, and jaw.

steps.title: Sketch the hair.
steps.body: Use a long curved line for the back of the head, and a series of shorter lines of different lengths for the hairline at the front.

steps.title: Use curved lines to draw the ear, to contour inside it, and to sketch the sideburns of hair in front of it.
Detail inside the ear with two more curved lines.
steps.body: Sketch the hair at the back of the head, using a series of short curved lines. Extend lines at the front and back of the head to indicate the neck.

steps.title: Use gently curved lines to enclose the rectangular shirt collar and the back of the shirt.
Use curved lines to texture the hair and to enclose the remaining side of the shirt collar.
Your head outline is now complete.
steps.body: Color your portrait.

lessons.title: A Mans Face
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Man's Face with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Man's Face.

steps.title: Begin the man’s face outline by drawing the eyes.
steps.body: Use curved lines to enclose the double-pointed almond shapes. Then, draw a circle inside a circle within each eye. Shade the pupils.

steps.title: Contour the upper and lower eyelids with curved lines.
steps.body: Then, outline the thick, pointed eyebrows.

steps.title: Draw the man’s nose.
steps.body: Use curved lines to outline the bridge of the nose, its tip, and nostrils.

steps.title: Draw the man’s lips.
steps.body: Use a long curved line for the opening of the mouth, with an additional curved line above and below it. Then, draw a small line at each corner.

steps.title: Use curved lines to sketch the neck, chin, and sides of the face.
steps.body: Notice how the line of the chin slightly overlaps those of the cheeks.

steps.title: Draw the ears.
steps.body: Use a “C” shaped line for the outer edge of each ear, with additional curved lines contouring inside it.

steps.title: Draw the man’s hair.
steps.body: Use a series of overlapping lines to draw the sweep of hair at the top of the head, some of them meeting at points. Use additional curved lines to indicate the sideburns above the ears.

steps.title: Continue drawing the hair at the side and top of the head.
steps.body: Again, use a series of curved lines, some of which meet at points.

steps.title: Complete your cartoon man’s face outline by enclosing the remaining hair above the ear.
steps.body: Then, texture the hair with short lines.

steps.title: Color your cartoon man’s face outline.
steps.body: In our illustration, the man is blonde, but you can get creative and give him any hair and skin tones you’d like.

lessons.title: An Old Man Face
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Old Man Face with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Old Man Face.

steps.title: Start with two curved horizontal lines, then connect them with two vertical lines and draw an oval in the center.
steps.body: Add a curve on top to make a lantern shape similar to a cartoon man's eyes.

steps.title: To the left, make a large loop with a smaller loop on the right.
steps.body: Add a vertical curve on top of the first loop. Sketch two diagonal lines that point outward, then connect them to make a rectangle and add a curve on the bottom.

steps.title: Draw an oval in the left eye, then sketch curves around both eyes.
steps.body: Use loose hill shapes to make a shape that resembles a flat-bottomed cloud.

steps.title: Repeat the previous step for the left eyebrow.
steps.body: Use more loose, wavy hill shapes to outline the mustache. Have fun making the lines wiggly and expressive.

steps.title: Sketch a curve underneath the mustache.
steps.body: Sketch more hills with varying shapes and lengths, like water dripping over the edge of a counter.

steps.title: Outline the face with a long hook shape on the left and a curve on the right.
steps.body: Make a loop with curves inside for the ear.

steps.title: Draw more loose, fluffy lines above the ear to make another cloud shape, then complete the head with a dome.
Complete the hair on either side with more sketchy hills.
Add another curve and oval for the left ear, then sketch dashes on the forehead.
steps.body: For more practice, challenge yourself to draw a full-body cartoon old man.

steps.title: Finally, color the outline with your favorite skin color.
steps.body: Leave the hair white for realism. Use shadows to make your old man's face look realistic.

lessons.title: George Washington
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking George Washington with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect George Washington.

steps.title: Begin by sketching the shape of the face.
steps.body: Use a series of curved lines. Note the curvature of the hairline, the bulge of the brow, the rounded jawline, and the line that extends to form the neck.

steps.title: Next, draw George Washington's hair.
steps.body: Use a series of overlapping "U" shaped lines at the bottom to form the curls. Use a long, wavy line to outline the top of the hair. Then, texture the hair using many short, curved lines.

steps.title: Begin to draw Washington's garments.
steps.body: Enclose the collar of the shirt using a curved line. Then, use a series of overlapping curved lines to craft the collar, front, and shoulder of his jacket.

steps.title: Continue drawing the garments.
steps.body: Extend the line of the neck, and connect it to the jacket with a curved line. Draw a pair of wavy curved lines to form the front of the jacket. Embellish the opposite side of the jacket with a wavy line.

steps.title: Extend a line from the jacket to form the remaining shoulder.
steps.body: Connect the two shoulders using a wide "U" shaped line. This gives the drawing the appearance of a bust or statue.

steps.title: Draw Washington's scarf.
steps.body: Use overlapping curved lines to outline the cloth. Then, draw several curved lines diverging from the top of it, indicating creases in the fabric. Draw two lines from the bottom of the scarf to the bottom of the figure.

steps.title: Begin to detail Washington's face.
steps.body: Shade heavy curved lines to indicate the eyebrows, and another to form the nose.

steps.title: Use curved lines, meeting at points on the corners, to outline the eyes.
steps.body: Draw two circles within each eye, and shade the inner circle to indicate the pupil.

steps.title: Use curved lines to draw the flat mouth and detail the chin.
Color George Washington.

lessons.title: Isaac Newton
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Isaac Newton with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Isaac Newton.

steps.title: Begin by sketching the features of Isaac Newton's face.
steps.body: Use curved lines to outline the eyes, contour the eyelids, and draw the eyebrows and nose. Then, shade a large circle inside each eye to indicate Isaac Newton's pupils.

steps.title: Draw the smiling mouth using a curved line, with a shorter curved line at its corner.
steps.body: Then, outline Newton's face using a long curved line. Complete the outline by drawing his hair. Draw his fluffy powdered wig using a series of short curved lines.

steps.title: Continue to draw the hair using a series of connected curved lines.
steps.body: Draw a line down the center of the head to indicate the part in the hair.

steps.title: Begin drawing Newton's garments.
steps.body: Use curved lines to trace his scarf, the neck of his coat, his sleeve, and its large cuff.

steps.title: Use overlapping curved lines to draw the hand, thumb, and fingers.
steps.body: Contour the knuckles with a short curved line. Then, draw an apple in his hand. Use a long curved line to outline the fruit. Extend another line from its top, and double it back upon itself to enclose the stem.

steps.title: Use curved lines to outline the front of the coat and the sides of the legs.
steps.body: Draw a circle below the hand to indicate the coat's button.

steps.title: Use curved lines to draw the remaining sleeve, cuff, hand, and fingers.
Use curved lines to complete the side and bottom of the pant leg.
steps.body: Extend two lines to form the leg, then use a curved line to trace the irregular shape of the shoe. On top of the shoe, draw a rounded rectangle within a rectangle, forming the metal buckle.

steps.title: Enclose the remaining pant leg.
steps.body: Draw the leg, shoe, and rectangular buckle.

steps.title: Color your cartoon caricature of the scientist Isaac Newton.

lessons.title: Jesus Face
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Jesus' Face with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Jesus' Face.

steps.title: Begin the Jesus’ face outline by drawing the almond-shaped eyes.
steps.body: Use two lines to sketch each eye, pointed in the corners. Then, draw two partial circle shapes inside each eye. Shade the smaller ones to indicate the pupils. Next, draw a curved line above each eye to form the eyelid.

steps.title: Use curved lines to draw the bushy eyebrows, the furrow between them, the bridge of the nose, its nostrils, and its tip.
Use curved lines to sketch the lips.
steps.body: Then, use a series of connected lines of different lengths to sketch the texture of the beard. Allow the lines to meet at points.

steps.title: Continue to use curved lines to draw the top of the beard and the sides of the face.
steps.body: Similarly, draw the mustache and beard around the mouth.

steps.title: Draw the top of the beard along the cheeks, again using a series of short curved lines.
steps.body: Texture the length of the beard with additional lines. Then, draw long, sweeping lines in an "M" shape above the head. From the center of the "M," draw additional lines to the legs of the "M." These lines form the hairline.

steps.title: Use long curved lines to continue drawing the hair.
steps.body: Notice how the lines overlap, giving the hair volume. Sketch the ears between the hair and the face, and contour the cheeks with overlapping lines.

steps.title: Continue to draw overlapping curved lines, making the hair long.
steps.body: At the bottom, allow lines to meet, forming pointed locks.

steps.title: Finish enclosing the hair, using lines that meet at points to form the locks.
steps.body: Use additional curved lines to texture the part in the hair, draw and contour the neck, and form the garments.

steps.title: Complete your Jesus face outline by texturing the hair and clothing using curved lines.
Color your cartoon of Jesus’ face.

lessons.title: The Police
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Police with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Police.

steps.title: Begin by sketching the police officer's face.
steps.body: Use curved lines to trace the irregular rounded shape of the eyes, as well as the eyelids, nose, and smiling mouth. Shade a large circle within each eye to indicate the pupils.

steps.title: Use curved lines to outline the sides of the head, the ears, the cheeks, and the chin.
steps.body: Additionally, use short curved lines for the eyebrows and to contour the inside of the ears.

steps.title: Use curved lines to outline the hair, the bill of the hat, the hatband, and the crown of the police hat.
Complete the outline of the police hat using a curved line.
steps.body: Then, draw an inverted curved triangle on the front of the hat. Next, use curved lines to draw the curved rectangular and triangular shapes of the shirt collar, enclosing the neck in the process. Use curved lines to draw the necktie and a curved line overlapping the shoulder. This line begins the officer's hand.

steps.title: Use curved lines to sketch the shield-like shape of the badge.
steps.body: Draw a large circle in the middle of the police badge, with a curved rectangle beneath it. Use curved lines to enclose the officer's fingers, as he is holding the badge.

steps.title: Draw a five-pointed star within the circle in the middle of the badge.
steps.body: Then, use curved lines to sketch the officer's body - his torso, shoulder, arm, and hand. Note the curved line that distinguishes his belt.

steps.title: Draw a square within a square to form the belt buckle.
steps.body: Draw a small oval overlapping the inner circle. Extend the belt using curved lines. Then, draw the circular shape of the handcuffs hanging from the belt. Note the bulge at the top of the circle and the curved line that gives them a three-dimensional appearance.

steps.title: Draw the other circular end of the handcuffs and complete the belt and torso.
steps.body: Use curved lines to begin sketching the leg, and the curved rectangular shape of the holster at the officer's hip.

steps.title: Use curved lines to complete the outline of the pants and enclose the irregular shape of the shoes.
Color your cartoon police officer.
steps.body: Most police sport blue uniforms, while sheriffs typically wear brown.

lessons.title: Zeus
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Zeus with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Zeus.

steps.title: Begin by sketching Zeus's eyes and nose.
steps.body: Use a curved line to sketch the nose and the side of one eye. Draw a short curved line beneath each eye, and enclose the eye using a second curved line. Contour the eyelid with a curved line and enclose two circles within each eye. Shade between them to indicate the pupil.

steps.title: Continue sketching the face and hair.
steps.body: Use a series of connected "U" shaped lines to outline the fluffy hair. Use two curved lines, connected at a point on each end, to draw the brow above each eye. Use curved lines to sketch the side of the face.

steps.title: Continue the series of "U" shaped lines to enclose Zeus's beard.
steps.body: Note the area enclosed inside the beard - the mouth. Use curved lines to outline the smiling mouth and contour the chin. Use a partial circle to outline the ear, and detail the inside of it with curved lines.

steps.title: Begin to sketch Zeus's torso and garments.
steps.body: Use logo, curved lines to outline the toga and to detail the folds of fabric. Use additional curved lines to outline the muscles of the chest.

steps.title: Draw Zeus's muscular arm.
steps.body: Use curved lines to sketch the shoulder muscles, upper arm, lower arm, and hand. Note the lines within the arm that contour the muscles.

steps.title: Draw Zeus's remaining arm.
steps.body: Use curved lines to sketch the bulging biceps muscles, the bottom of the upper arm, the lower arm, the base of the hand, and the thumb.

steps.title: Use straight lines to create the zigzag pattern of a lightning bolt in Zeus's hand.
steps.body: Then, draw several overlapping ovals to indicate his fingers curled around it.

steps.title: Draw a circle below the chest to indicate the belt buckle.
steps.body: Give it a three-dimensional appearance by drawing a curved line around one side. Then, use parallel curved lines to draw the belt itself. Connect the lines with short lines on each end. Extend additional curved lines beneath the belt to indicate the sides of the garment, and more lines to texture the folds of the cloth.

steps.title: Draw a horizontal straight line beneath the character.
steps.body: Then, enclose a shape using a series of overlapping spiral and "U" shaped lines. This cloud should appear to cover Zeus's feet.

steps.title: Color Zeus.
steps.body: Then, check out our cartoon character drawing guides to fill the ranks of Mount Olympus.

lessons.title: Abraham Lincoln
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Abraham Lincoln with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial, plus FREE printable pages.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Abraham Lincoln.

steps.title: Begin by drawing Abe Lincoln’s signature tophat.
steps.body: Draw two parallel curved lines, and attach them at the top with a third curved line.

steps.title: Draw a “C” shaped line at the bottom of the hat to outline the brim.
Draw a curved line across the base of the hat’s crown to outline the hatband.
Sketch Lincoln's hair and beard.
steps.body: Draw a curved line to indicate where his head meets the hat. Then, draw the hair using a series of curved lines that meet at jagged points. Notice the “C” shaped ear. The hair should jut out at the forehead, behind the ear, and in front of the ear, forming an “L” shape to create the beard.

steps.title: Draw the ear, erasing as necessary.
steps.body: Outline the ear with a “C” shaped line, and detail the inside with curved lines.

steps.title: Sketch the face in profile.
steps.body: Use a curved line for the forehead and nose, another for the cheek. Extend another for the upper lip, and a final one for the lower lip and chin.

steps.title: Outline the eye with a “V” shaped line and a curved line between it.
steps.body: Use a curved line to enclose the pupil. Draw the eyebrow using several curved lines, some of which meet at jagged points.

steps.title: Draw the collar of Lincoln’s suit, erasing as necessary.
steps.body: Extend curved lines from the hair at the base of the neck, and connect them at the end to form a loosely rectangular shape. Draw the circular button at the end.

steps.title: Complete the collar, enclosing a loosely triangular shape with straight and curved lines.
Color your cartoon of Lincoln.
steps.body: Abe Lincoln had black hair and in most of his photographs, he wore a black suit and white shirt.

lessons.title: Neymar Jr
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Neymar Jr with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Neymar Jr.

steps.title: Draw two almond-shaped eyes and add round pupils; sketch curved eyebrows above them.
Outline the eyelids and gently curve the lines to form the nose.
Add the nose tip and draw the mouth with curved lines forming the lips, shading the corners.
Draw wavy lines above the mouth for the mustache and outline the chin and beard.
Add “C”-shaped ears and outline the beard edges with curved lines.
Sketch inner ear details and outline the sides of the face, adding a wavy hairline.
Enclose the hair with curved lines, finish the sideburns and neck.
Extend lines from the neck to form the shoulders and draw a “V”-shaped neckline with a collar.
Add shirt details like sleeves, folds, and a button.
Color the drawing — brown hair, and the shirt in any team colors you like.

lessons.title: Cristiano Ronaldo
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Cristiano Ronaldo with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Cristiano Ronaldo.

steps.title: Sketch two narrow lemon shapes in the center of the page, then draw circles inside them; add curves above the eyes and dashes beneath.
Draw the eyebrows with thick, crooked dashes; sketch a curve beneath each eye and a dash above the right eyebrow.
Outline the nose with a curved horizontal line and a vertical curve on each side; add dashes on the nose.
steps.body: Start the mouth with an uneven line, then add a curve below and dashes on both sides; sketch a thin curve between the nose and mouth.

steps.title: Below the mouth, draw a V-shaped line with a rounded bottom; add two vertical lines to this shape, then sketch lines around the mouth.
Draw a wide M-shape above the face and two vertical triangles near the eyebrows; connect these shapes with wavy lines and add dashes above the eyebrows.
Sketch the ears with uneven ovals and draw curves inside them; for the hair, draw several triangles, then connect the hair to the ears with vertical lines and sketch diagonal lines inside the hair.
Outline the neck with curved lines and sketch diagonal lines inside the neck.
Draw a V-shape below the neck, then add another V-shape beneath it and loosely connect the shapes with two vertical lines.
Complete the shoulders with a sideways L-shape and short diagonal line on each side; then outline the drawing with a pen, fill in eyebrows and pupils, and erase pencil lines.
Color your drawing — use natural skin tones for the face, dark brown or black for the hair, and add the jersey color (often red or white, depending on his team).
steps.body: Shade carefully to keep the portrait lifelike.

lessons.title: Lionel Messi Easy
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Lionel Messi Easy with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Lionel Messi Easy.

steps.title: Begin the Lionel Messi outline by drawing his eyes using curved lines to sketch the double-pointed shapes, shade a circle inside each eye and contour the upper eyelids.
Use curved lines to sketch his bushy, pointed eyebrows, noting short lines between brows, contour lower eyelids and nose area.
Draw the tip of the nose, the mouth, and lower lip with curved lines; sketch the top mustache with short curved strokes.
Sketch the mustache above the mouth and beard below with short connected curved and U-shaped lines to give texture.
Use long curved lines to draw the sides of the face, double back to form tops of ears; complete ears and add more beard detail with short lines.
Contour inside the ears with curved lines; draw short lines above ears and across forehead for hairline.
Draw the hair atop head with connected curved lines; contour sides of face between eyes and ears.

Texture the beard with many short lines between facial contours and mustache edges; draw straight lines below head for neck and extend curved lines for shoulders and upper arms; form a U-shape under neck for shirt neckline and contour neck.
Texture the hair with curved lines of varying lengths; add U-shaped lines around shirt collar and distinguish torso from sleeves with curved lines.
Color your drawing — brown hair, skin tones, and use red & blue or white & light blue for his team jersey.

lessons.title: Sherlock Holmes
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Sherlock Holmes with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Sherlock Holmes.

steps.title: Begin the Sherlock Holmes outline by drawing his face in profile with a long curved line to show a strong nose.
Extend the nose line, sketch the lips, chin, and jaw, and add the nostril with a “U”-shaped line; draw a small curved line at the corner of the mouth.

Start the iconic hat: draw a curved brim above the face, extend lines and double them back to form the bill, and join it with the face outline; sketch ear and sideburns plus bushy eyebrow with short curved lines.
Contour inside the ear with curved lines; extend a curved line from the hat to form the back flap, and enclose the hat top with two lines meeting at a point.

Use connected curved lines to enclose hair at the back of the head; draw neck lines from hair and chin and connect them with a long curve forming the shirt collar; add contour lines to ear, nose, and neck.
Use overlapping curved lines to draw the coat lapel, shirt collar, and necktie.
Enclose the coat shoulders and body with long lines; draw a curved line from mouth doubled back to outline his pipe.
Add pipe details: band it with curves, draw the opening with a “C” line, and use wavy lines to suggest smoke rising.
Refine the outline: contour hat, lips, cheekbone, and facial skin lines for clarity and accuracy.
Color your drawing — Sherlock Holmes is usually depicted in brown tones: brown hair, brown coat and hat, and a light skin tone.

lessons.title: Captain Jack Sparrow
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Captain Jack Sparrow with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Captain Jack Sparrow.

steps.title: Begin the Captain Jack Sparrow outline by drawing his face with curved lines for eyes, nose, and mouth; shade pupils in each eye.
Next, outline the face side using a long curve, and draw the chin with jagged short lines to begin the beard; add eyebrows and contour around the eyes and lower lip.
Continue the beard and mustache lines using short jagged strokes; sketch small circles, ovals, and crescents for beaded braids below the beard.
Above the face, draw a long wavy line doubling back to form the top of the hat, and below it sketch the bandana with overlapping curved lines.
Draw a curved line across the hat top, then draw hair at the side of his face using overlapping curves and enclose a braid with round beads.
Add more braid decorations (rectangles, ovals, circles) and another braid with overlapping curves; draw a wavy rectangular hair tie at braid end.
Use overlapping curved lines meeting at jagged points to sketch neck, hair, and top of his clothing beneath the head.
Draw shoulders, sleeves, triangular shirt collar, and a strap with buckle using curved lines.
On the other side of the face, draw hair and bandana contour; add circles and hexagons in some beads on braids.
Color your drawing — dark brown hair, red bandana, black pirate hat, natural skin tones, and color the beads and clothing as you like.

lessons.title: An Easy Mona Lisa
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Easy Mona Lisa with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Easy Mona Lisa.

steps.title: Begin the easy Mona Lisa outline by sketching her face using curved lines for her eyes, eyelids, eyebrows, nose, lips, and a cheek dimple; draw a small circle inside each eye and shade a smaller circle within.
Use a series of curved lines to trace the outline of her face and the wavy edges of her hair around it.
Continue drawing Mona Lisa’s hair with long and wavy curved lines, include the part in her hair, and draw her neck plus a short line for the collarbone.
Begin drawing her garments using long curved lines, and connect them at the top with a pair of curved lines.
Use overlapping curved lines to draw the wavy folds of her sleeve.
Draw her hand using long overlapping curved lines and add short lines for fingernails; continue the fabric folds of her robe.
Continue the sleeve and draw her folded second hand beneath the first, shading the lower sleeves with curved and “V”-shaped lines.
Texture the sash of her robe with curved lines, add a zigzag band on the upper sleeve, and draw straight “ray” lines around the neckline of her dress.
Continue contouring the fabric with curved lines to complete the outline of her clothing.
Color your drawing — use pale cream for skin, brown hair, and brown tones for her garments.

categories.name: Plant
categories.description: Discover an endless array of cool pictures to draw with our selection of plant, flower, and tree drawing tutorials. How might you use these easy drawing guides, designed for kids of all ages?

lessons.title: Draw Christmas Tree
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Easy Christmas Tree with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Easy Christmas Tree.

steps.title: Begin your cartoon Christmas tree outline by drawing the star on top of it using straight lines to craft the five-pointed star.
Extend two straight lines in an inverted “V” shape below the star to form the top of the tree.
Use three connected curved lines to attach one side of the “V” to the other, indicating the first bough.
From the top segment of the tree, extend two straight lines downward, then draw a short curved line at the end of each to form the next section.
Finish connecting the sides of the tree using a series of scalloped curved lines, then extend two straight lines below and draw a curved line to connect them.
Use more curved lines to complete the scalloped pattern on the lower part of the tree; below this, extend two straight lines and connect them with a curved line to form the trunk.
Decorate the tree by drawing a pair of parallel curved lines across each tree segment to represent ribbons or tinsel.
Draw circular ornaments on the tree and a “J” shape intersecting one of the ribbons to depict a candy cane.
Erase any unnecessary guideline lines on the candy cane and fill in the rest of the tree with round ornaments of various sizes.

lessons.title: Draw Palm Tree Really Easy Drawing Tutorial
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Palm Tree with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Palm Tree.

steps.title: Begin by drawing two long, curved lines, parallel to one another.
steps.body: Make sure the lines are a bit closer together at the top than at the bottom. These lines form the trunk of the palm tree.

steps.title: Just above the trunk, draw five curved lines going in different directions.
steps.body: The lines will meet above the trunk, forming a shape like a droopy five-pointed star. These lines are the beginning of the palm tree's leaves, or fronds.

steps.title: Begin to outline some of the leaves.
steps.body: For the first leaf, draw a curved line from the middle of the star shape to the tip of one curved line. Then, do the same on the opposite side of the same curved line. You will have enclosed a rounded shape that is pointed on each end. Repeat this process to enclose another leaf.

steps.title: Continue to to outline leaves by drawing curved lines from the base to the tip of the original lines.
In this step, you will draw a leaf from a different angle.
steps.body: On your remaining curved line, enclose a shape by drawing a nearly straight line from the base to the tip. Then, draw a few more leaves in profile, using a curved line and a nearly straight line for each. Erase guide lines as needed.

steps.title: Add detail to the leaves.
steps.body: Using short lines, enclose a few small triangle shapes along the edges of each leaf.

steps.title: Draw three small circles at the point where the leaves meet, called the crown of the tree.
steps.body: These circles form coconuts, the fruit of the palm tree.

steps.title: Erase guide lines from the coconuts and the leaves.
steps.body: The leaves will now have a jagged appearance.

steps.title: Draw curved, horizontal lines along the trunk of the tree.
Color your palm tree.

lessons.title: A Leaf
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Maple Leaf with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Maple Leaf.

steps.title: Begin by drawing the leaf margin using curved lines that meet at sharp or gentle points to start the outline.
Continue outlining the edge of the leaf with curved lines that meet at points, forming lobes.
Mirror the same lobed outline on the other side of the leaf using curved lines meeting at points.
Use curved lines of various sizes to complete the upper lobes and add indentations.
Finish the outline of the leaf, closing the shape at the base.
From the central base, draw the midrib — a long curved line up the center of the leaf.
Add primary veins: draw curved lines branching out from the midrib toward each lobe.
Add secondary veins: draw shorter curved lines extending from the primary veins into the lobes.
Continue adding small branching veins for detail and texture.
Color your drawing — in spring/summer leaves are bright green; in autumn they may be yellow, orange, red, or brown.

lessons.title: A Rainbow Flower
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Rainbow Flower with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Rainbow Flower.

steps.title: Begin the rainbow flower outline by drawing a circle to form the center of the flower (the flower’s “face”).
Draw two curved lines inside the circle to form a rounded “M” shape for the upper part of the eyes.
Add curved lines for eyebrows and the smiling mouth, and shade two small circles below the eyes as pupils.
Complete the mouth by drawing a curved line for the bottom lip and little curves at each corner; add tongue detail.
Extend a curved line from the top of the face and double it back to begin the first petal’s outline.
Continue drawing long curved lines all around the face to form the remaining petals.
Once all petals are finished, draw two curved lines downward from the base of the flower to form the stem.
Draw teardrop-shaped leaves on each side of the stem using curved lines.
At the bottom, draw curved, wavy lines to indicate grass and draw a horizon line behind the flower.
Color your drawing — color each petal a different hue of the rainbow, green stem and leaves, and brown or dark color for ground.

lessons.title: A Flower Garden
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Flower Garden with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Flower Garden.

steps.title: Start by drawing a slightly curved horizontal line near the bottom to represent the ground.
Sketch a simple cloud or two in the sky above the ground line using curved, fluffy shapes.
Along the ground, draw stems (long straight or gently curved lines) rising upward at different heights.
At the top of each stem, draw small circles or ovals to mark the center of each flower.
Around each flower center, draw petals using curved lines radiating outward in various shapes.
Add more flowers behind and between by layering additional stems, centers, and petals.
Draw leaves on the stems using curved “teardrop” or elongated oval shapes.
Add details to petals and leaves: small curves, lines, and overlapping shapes for realism.
Fill in the background: draw grass tufts, more flowers or foliage behind, and perhaps a sun or sky detail.
Color your drawing — use bright colors for flowers, green for leaves and stems, and blue or light sky tones for background.

lessons.title: Tulips In A Pot
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Tulips in a Pot with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Tulips in a Pot.

steps.title: Begin the tulips in a pot outline by drawing the leaves — for each leaf, draw two curved lines that meet at a point.
Draw the first tulip: extend a pair of lines from between the leaves, let them diverge and become wavy near the top, then enclose petal shapes with a “C”-shaped line.
Use overlapping wavy lines to draw more petals of the first tulip.
Draw a second tulip: extend a pair of lines upward from between the leaves and use wavy, irregular semi-circles for petals.
Enclose the petals of the second tulip using long curved lines.
Begin the third tulip: extend the two stem lines from between the leaves.
Enclose the petals of the third flower using long curved lines.
Add extra petals to the third tulip with wavy lines, then sketch the top of the pot (rounded opening) and the base of the pot.
Complete the outline by drawing additional leaves behind the flowers using pairs of curved lines meeting at sharp points.
Color your drawing — choose nice colors for the tulips, green for leaves, and earthy tones for the pot.

lessons.title: A Potted Plant
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Potted Plant with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Potted Plant.

steps.title: Begin by drawing the flower pot — use curved lines for the pot body, outline the rim top and bottom.
Sketch the base of the plant by drawing a short curved line meeting one side of the pot, and use “U” shapes to suggest soil in front and behind the plant.
Draw a large leaf: extend two curved lines from the pot/stem, let them meet at a point, then draw a midrib (center vein).
Continue another stem: draw curved lines upward, then enclose another leaf with curved lines meeting at a point.
Add detail to the leaf: draw the vein line down its center, and sketch a small notched “bite” mark on its edge.
On the main stem, draw a “V” shape to split it into branches, and enclose another leaf on one branch.
Draw the vein inside that leaf and a small hole or notch in its edge; then begin sketching petals of the flower using overlapping “U” shapes.
Continue adding overlapping “U” shapes to complete the flower blossom above the leaves.
Add decorative detail: draw curved lines to outline the flower’s center, add filaments with small circles at the tips.
Color your drawing — choose bright tropical colors for the flower (red, orange, pink, yellow), green for leaves and brown or earthy tone for the pot.

lessons.title: A Flower Bouquet
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Flower Bouquet with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Flower Bouquet.

steps.title: Begin by drawing your first flower: draw a circle for its center, then enclose rounded “U” shaped lines around it as petals.
Draw a second flower beside the first: sketch a small circle, then use “U” shapes to enclose the petals.
Draw a third flower: another circle for the center, then surround it with “U” shaped petals.
Next, draw a tulip: from behind one of the first flowers, draw two straight parallel lines for the stem, then draw a “U” shape and connect its ends with a “W” shape to create petals.
Behind other flowers, draw another tulip similarly: two stem lines, “U” bottom, and “W” top to enclose petals.
Sketch leaves: draw pairs of curved lines meeting at a point for each leaf, filling gaps between flowers.
Continue adding overlapping leaves until the bouquet shape is enclosed; add a vein line inside some leaves.
Add more small flowers: draw stems with parallel lines, circles for centers, and curved lines for petals with wavy edges.

Draw the stems of the bouquet: extend pairs of lines downward, join them with an irregular shape to form a ribbon, draw bow loops and ribbon ends with teardrop and “V” shapes, and detail them with curved lines.
Color your bouquet — choose colors for each flower, green for leaves and stems, and appropriate ribbon color.

lessons.title: A Cartoon Sunflower
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Cartoon Sunflower with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Cartoon Sunflower.

steps.title: Draw a small circle for the center of the sunflower.
Around that circle, draw a ring of curved petal outlines, each petal shaped like an elongated teardrop.
Inside the center circle, draw a smaller circle and fill it with small dots or texture lines.
Around the first ring of petals, draw a second ring of petals, offset so they appear between the petals of the first ring.
Extend two curved lines downward from the bottom petals to form the stem.
Along the stem, draw two large leaves using curved lines that meet at a point.
Inside each leaf, draw a central vein and a few smaller veins branching outward.
Add small texture lines to petals (short curved lines near the petal base) and slight shading inside the sunflower center.
Refine the outlines, ensuring petals, leaves, and stem are smooth and clear.
Color your drawing — yellow petals, brown center, green stem and leaves.

lessons.title: A Cosmos Flower
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Cosmos Flower with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Cosmos Flower.
Get F

steps.title: Start by drawing the center of the first cosmos flower using a curved, fringed circle of small “U” shapes.
From that center, draw pairs of curved lines outward and connect them with wavy lines to make petals.
Continue adding ray petals around the center until the first flower is complete.
Extend two curved lines downward from the first flower to form the stem.
On the stem, draw a second blossom: create the center with “U” shapes and then enclose petals with curved lines.
Add petals around the second center in the same way, filling out that flower.
Draw another stem branching off from the main stem using curved lines.
At the end of that branch, draw the third flower: center with “U” shapes, then petals with curved and wavy lines.
Add leaves and branching stems: draw pairs of curved lines, some splitting into “Y” shapes, and small leaves along them.
Color your drawing — yellow centers, petals in orange/pink/purple/red, and green stems/leaves.
Draw a large, oblong oval near the top of the page with two bumps on the left.
steps.body: Add a vertical line on either side of this shape.

steps.title: From the edges of the oval, draw two slightly curved lines downward on each side to form the sides of the stump.
Outline the grass on the left with loose, sketchy triangles.
steps.body: On the right, draw another hill, a curve and a wavy line that trails downward.

steps.title: Draw a line of grass across the bottom of the trunk.
steps.body: Make the blades look spiky and uneven.

steps.title: Sketch a curved line on either side of the trunk, then draw another line of grass on the right.
Add grass on the left.
steps.body: Sketch a vertical line inside the trunk, and draw two curves.

steps.title: Draw another vertical line inside the trunk.
steps.body: On the left, sketch two lines and enclose one with a football shape to make a leaf. To the right, draw a loose heart shape with a pointy top.

steps.title: Add another leaf with a wide teardrop shape.
steps.body: Sketch an oval in the center of the stump, then surround it with two more ovals. Make them uneven with spaces between the lines like water ripples.

steps.title: Draw another loose oval on the surface of the stump.
steps.body: Next, draw six diagonal lines that radiate outward from the center.

steps.title: Color your drawing — brown tones for the stump, darker browns for cracks, and earthy tones around the base.

lessons.title: A Snake Plant
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Snake Plant with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Snake Plant.

steps.title: Sketch a curve near the bottom of the page.
steps.body: Add two diagonal lines on either side, then draw another curve between them.

steps.title: Use swooping curves to draw wide triangles.
steps.body: The left triangle should have a narrow tip.

steps.title: Sketch another triangle that ends in a curve and a shape with two overlapping triangles, one smaller than the other.
Complete the plant that you drew earlier, then draw two more curved triangles, adding a line that reaches the top of the page.
Draw another curve at the top, and sketch more curves inside the leaves for realism.
steps.body: Make the curves parallel to the outline that you just drew.

steps.title: Add more curves inside the leaves.
steps.body: Sketch a dash to complete your house plant vase, and sketch two curves inside the container.

steps.title: Draw several squiggly lines inside three leaves on the left.
steps.body: Make the lines thinner so that they don't stand out as much as the outline. The lines should resemble small waves.

steps.title: Add several squiggly lines to two leaves on the right.
steps.body: Vary the lengths, shapes and sizes to give the leaves more texture.

steps.title: Draw more squiggly lines inside the remaining two leaves.
steps.body: Outline your easy house plant drawing with a black pen or marker, then erase the pencil lines once the ink dries.

steps.title: Color the edges of the snake plant pale yellow, then use dark and green stripes for the inner sections.

lessons.title: Cartoon Flowers
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Cartoon Flowers with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Cartoon Flowers.

steps.title: Begin by drawing a long, wavy line.
Draw another wavy line parallel to the first.
steps.body: The lines should be closer to one another at the top than at the bottom. This forms the main stem.

steps.title: Draw one curved line extending from each side of the stem.
Draw another curved line parallel to each of the curved lines you just drew.
steps.body: These lines form secondary stems.

steps.title: Draw a circle above the tip of the left secondary stem.
Draw five petals around the circle.
steps.body: Each petal will consist of a curved line in the shape of a very rounded "M." The bottom two petals should connect the flower to its stem.

steps.title: Draw a circle above the main stem.
Draw five "M" shapped petals around the circle.
steps.body: The bottom petals will connect this flower to the main stem.

steps.title: Draw a circle above the right secondary stem.
Draw five loosely "M" shaped petals around the circle.
steps.body: The bottom two petals will connect the flower to its stem.

steps.title: Now, you will add detail to the petals.
steps.body: Beginning with the flower on the left, add a wavy line to the interior of each petal. Each line should extend from the flower's circle center, form three humps, then attach to the center once more.

steps.title: Repeat this process to add detail to the center flower's petals.
Repeat the process to add detail to the petals of right flower, again using five wavy lines.
Extend a short, curved line from each side of the center flower's stem.
steps.body: Draw similar lines from the left side of the left secondary stem, and the right side of the right secondary stem. These lines will form the veins of leaves.

steps.title: Outline the leaves using two curved lines each.
steps.body: The lines should extend from the stem and come together to form a point with the leaf vein line.

steps.title: Draw the grass in which your flower is growing.
steps.body: To draw grass, use short, curved lines that come together in a point, both at their base and at their tip. The result will resemble connected curving triangles with no base line.

steps.title: Complete the mound of grass by connecting the far sides with a straight line.
steps.body: Add detail to the veins of the leaves by drawing one to two short, slightly curving lines extending from both sides of each leaf vein.

steps.title: Now, you will add faces to your flowers.
steps.body: Within the center circle of each flower, draw two smaller circles for eyes. Below the eyes, form a smiling mouth by drawing a "U" shaped line. Draw a short line perpendicular to each end of the "U" shaped line.

steps.title: Within each eye circle, draw a smaller circle.
steps.body: You can determine the direction in which the flower appears to be looking by drawing this small circle on that side of the eye. Draw a tiny circle within each small circle. Shade the small circle.

steps.title: Complete your sketch by coloring your flowers.
steps.body: Make them any color you want - have fun!

lessons.title: A Banana Tree
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Banana Tree with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Banana Tree.

steps.title: Begin the banana tree outline by drawing the grass growing at the base of the tree.
steps.body: Use curved lines of different lengths that meet at jagged points. Then, begin drawing the trunk of the tree. It is made of repeating layers of two triangles followed by one triangle.

steps.title: Continue using curved triangles to draw the trunk of the cartoon banana tree.
steps.body: Then, extend parallel, curved lines from the top of the trunk. Allow the lines to meet at a sharp point. Then, use a series of curved lines to begin drawing the palm tree-like leaf.

steps.title: Continue sketching the leaf, using curved "V" shaped lines to trace the irregular edge of the leaf.
steps.body: Then, draw a second leaf. Extend a pair of curved lines from the trunk, then use a wavy, curved line to begin drawing the side of the leaf.

steps.title: Complete the leaf.
steps.body: Notice that this one is curled, doubling over on itself. Use curved lines that meet at a point to continue the central vein. Then, draw another banana leaf. Extend a pair of curved lines from the trunk, then use a wavy, curved line to begin drawing the side of the leaf.

steps.title: Complete the outline of the leaf using a series of curved lines.
steps.body: Notice that this leaf, too, is bent. Then, begin sketching the fourth leaf. Extend a pair of curved lines from the top of the trunk, and allow them to meet at a sharp point.

steps.title: Finish the outline of the fourth leaf, using a series of curved lines to sketch its serrated edges.
steps.body: Then, begin drawing a bunch of bananas hanging from the tree. Enclose many overlapping, elongated shapes with rounded ends. The shapes should in turn form a half-circle shape.

steps.title: Use "U" shaped lines to draw three more rows of bananas visible above the first.
steps.body: Then, draw the remains of the banana flower below the bunch of fruit. Extend two wavy lines, then connect them at the bottom by drawing an upside-down teardrop shape.

steps.title: Connect the bunch of bananas to the tree using a pair of parallel curved lines, erasing as necessary.
steps.body: Then, draw a few more leaves in the background. Again, extend pairs of curved lines that meet at points to form the leaf veins. Then, use a series of curved lines to outline the edges of the leaves.

steps.title: Complete your banana tree outline by drawing the tips of two more leaves hanging down at the back of the tree.
Color your cartoon banana tree.
steps.body: The tree itself is light green in color, even the trunk. Bananas can be green, yellow, or even pink.

lessons.title: An Easy Reflection Drawing Mountain Landscape
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Easy Reflection Drawing - Mountain Landscape with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Easy Reflection Drawing - Mountain Landscape.

steps.title: Draw a wavy line near the middle of the page.
steps.body: Sketch shorter lines on either side, then use loops to draw the grass like you're outlining a cloud.

steps.title: Sketch vertical loops with a tall loop on top to make the first tree.
steps.body: Add a few lines inside the tree, then repeat the previous step to start the next tree. Repeat Step 1 to sketch grass on the other side of the lake.

steps.title: Repeat Step 2 to draw more trees.
steps.body: Trees don't grow perfectly, so make the loops sketchy and uneven. Some trees should overlap the others to give the drawing depth.

steps.title: Repeat Step 3 to outline more trees.
steps.body: Fill the left side of the background with trees so that you can't see the horizon.

steps.title: Draw the rest of the grass, then use uneven straight lines to draw the mountains.
steps.body: The biggest mountain should have a rounded top. This should look similar to a cartoon mountains landscape drawing.

steps.title: Sketch the third mountain, then loosely sketch lines inside each mountain for added detail.
steps.body: Use loops to draw a fluffy cloud. Draw smaller loops inside the water.

steps.title: Outline the trees' reflection with more loops.
steps.body: Make sure that the size and shape of the loops line up with the trees that you drew earlier.

steps.title: Repeat this process for the trees and grass, then sketch the mountains' reflection.
steps.body: Instead of straight lines, draw rushed, sketchy lines on the bottom half of the mountains to show the rippling water.

steps.title: Repeat Step 8 for the cloud and lines inside the mountains, which should look squiggly like lightning bolts.
Outline your cartoon mountain landscape with a black pen.
steps.body: Use brown for the mountains, blue for the sky, yellow for the bank and green for the trees and grass. Color the reflection with slightly different colors for added realism--the water makes the shades look different.
